entries.title: Indirect injection through research snippets
entries.rationale: Governance policy established in Prompt 0a: untrusted-by-default trust policy (Rule-1/3/4) documented at artifacts/code/TASK-1021.code.md §Trust Policy. Starter red-team cases RT-INJECTION-001/002/003 define detection scenarios. Runtime enforcement deferred to Prompt 1+ (TASK-1006+). RT-INJECTION-004 (TASK-1019 Prompt 6e) confirmed: RACI_MATRIX_V2 blocks research-injected governance overrides; guard_contract_validator --audit-raci exits 1 VIOLATION regardless of research artifact content. || 2026-06-28 UPDATE (out-of-cadence, PR #37): the deferred runtime enforcement is now implemented as a fail-closed CI gate. prompt_injection_scan.py detects high-confidence injection shapes (instruction override; role/system impersonation; system-prompt & credential exfiltration; workflow-gate subversion; command coercion; smuggled invisible/bidi/tag Unicode; markdown exfil beacons) across the whole artifact surface (strict tier) and additionally over the untrusted external-input zone *.tavily_raw.md (lexical tier). Calibrated 100% recall / 0 false positives against the 36-case bilingual adversarial corpus (artifacts/red_team/prompt_injection_corpus.jsonl); the prompt-injection CI job fails closed on any missed attack, false positive, or unjustified finding. This realises the 'runtime guard' exit criterion as a DETECTIVE control at the CI/intake boundary over exactly the research-snippet surface FIND-23 names.
entries.finalized_by: TASK-1012 (v3.4 baseline); status advanced by security-hardening-engagement-2026Q2 (PR #37)
entries.residual_risk: Detective control: detect-and-block at commit/CI time, NOT a preventive per-read structural trust-tagging guard that stops an agent from ever treating content as authoritative at read-time. A read-time intake trust-boundary remains as defense-in-depth backlog. Snapshot finalization (Mitigated in the frozen inventory) deferred to the next quarterly threat-model exercise per docs/security_cadence.md.

entries.title: Memory-bank cumulative poisoning
entries.rationale: Governance policy established in Prompt 0a: source-ref-required authority policy (Rule-2/4) documented at artifacts/code/TASK-1021.code.md §Trust Policy. Starter red-team cases RT-MEMORY-001/002 define detection scenarios. Runtime enforcement deferred to Prompt 1+ (TASK-1006+). RT-MEMORY-POISON-001 (TASK-1019 Prompt 6e) confirmed: RACI_MATRIX_V2 is the sole authoritative source; .github/memory-bank/ files are not read by the validator; narrative authority claims have no effect. || 2026-06-28 NOTE (PR #37): a reusable injection detector (prompt_injection_scan.py) now exists and COULD be extended to the memory-bank intake boundary, but its current scan scope is artifacts/ only and does NOT cover .github/memory-bank/. FIND-24 therefore remains In-Progress; no status change. Extending the detector (or an equivalent structural guard) to memory-bank intake is the concrete next step toward Mitigated.

entries.title: Availability: catastrophic regex backtracking (ReDoS) in guard validators
entries.rationale: Threat class absent from the v3.4 inventory, surfaced by the 2026Q2 security audit: a maliciously crafted artifact field can trigger catastrophic backtracking in guard-validator regexes (root cause of REDOS-01 / REDOS-02), stalling CI and local validation (availability denial-of-service against the workflow's own gates). Instances fixed via linear rewrites (REDOS-01 research-source entry pattern; REDOS-02 citation pattern), each equivalence-verified with a fixed battery plus 20k fuzz inputs. Systemic recurrence is prevented by regex_safety_audit.py: a fail-closed CI gate (regex-safety job) that rejects any re.compile pattern carrying a ReDoS-prone shape (nested quantifier; the .+\..+ unbounded-double-dot motif; dual tempered fill) unless it carries a reviewed `# redos-ok:` justification. Heuristic validated against 100 in-repo compiled patterns (only 6 flagged, all audit-cleared as linear-safe). New finding proposed for inclusion in the next quarterly snapshot.
entries.residual_risk: Shape-based heuristic: a novel non-shape ReDoS construction could evade the linter. Bounded by the repo convention of linear-by-construction patterns with explicit quantifier bounds, and by the `# redos-ok:` review requirement for any flagged pattern.
